do_not_change.summary: Preserve the bounded manual-attempt semantics for a hard-crashed claimed Run.
do_not_change.evidence: Exact replay returns an honestly running stored Run without repeating phases, while a distinct key can create a separate explicit attempt, matching the existing priority-check model.
do_not_change.impact: Avoids inventing unsafe abandonment, lease or automatic resume semantics.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep running-replay and distinct-request-key tests and defer recovery-state design.
